baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated finding clause binds qawm, faith, reciprocal attachment, and active opposition in one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Finding and existence frame a test of social coherence: a people settled in trusting assent cannot also be constituted by reciprocal attachment to someone positioned across the divine boundary. The construction diagnoses incompatible group-forming relations rather than merely issuing an isolated command.

activation_trace.role: Finding or encountering makes the claim an observable test: such a coherent people cannot be located.
The existence branch strengthens the negation from advice toward constitutive incompatibility.
Qawm supplies the collective whose coherence, not only each member's passing feeling, is under examination.
Faith contributes assent in which the heart becomes settled, the positive center of the collective.
Mutual love or attachment is the rival relation being tested, not mere contact with an opponent.
Active opposition supplies the directed stance that makes reciprocal attachment structurally contradictory.

changed_reading.before: The line is only a rule telling individual believers not to love enemies.
changed_reading.after: The line is also a diagnostic of communal constitution: settled faith and reciprocal attachment to active opposition cannot jointly organize the same people.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concession moves through fathers, sons, brothers, and clan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The list traverses inherited belonging in four directions: formative ancestry, descending lineage, lateral kinship, and the enveloping field of close association and clan. The verse does not erase those relations; by naming them accurately, it denies each layer the power to overrule the God-facing boundary.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and upbringing anchor the formative, upward direction of inherited obligation.
Sonship and descent extend the test downward into what proceeds from one's own line.
Brotherhood supplies the lateral relation of shared kinship.
The tether image sharpens sibling relation as a binding tie whose pull is nevertheless not ultimate.
Mingling and close association broaden kinship into daily social interpenetration.
Clan and collective identity complete the topology at its widest inherited scale.

changed_reading.before: The relatives are a loose set of examples of forbidden affection.
changed_reading.after: The sequence maps the full topology of inherited identity and says that no layer, from parent to clan, can become the decisive source of allegiance when it crosses the divine boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: God writes faith in their hearts and supports them with a spirit from Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: The social boundary is generated from an inward event: faith is inscribed and made binding in the heart, then given living force by divine support. Allegiance is therefore portrayed as an inhabited and strengthened interior orientation, not as self-manufactured hostility.

activation_trace.role: Writing supplies the concrete image of faith inscribed rather than merely asserted.
Binding establishment gives the inscription durable normative force.
The heart is the interior faculty in which the divine writing becomes operative.
Security and trust describe the settled condition produced in that interior.
Support adds effective strength to the written orientation.
Spirit supplies life to the support, making the interior inscription dynamic rather than inert.

changed_reading.before: God rewards people who independently possess a doctrinal belief.
changed_reading.after: Their stable allegiance proceeds from faith divinely inscribed in the heart and animated by divine support, so the verse centers formation before exclusion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Entry into gardens with flowing rivers and lasting mutual satisfaction culminates in the doubled party declaration and success.
baseline_models.mechanism: The inwardly supported people are placed in a matching habitat: they enter a covered garden whose water moves, remain there, and participate in reciprocal satisfaction. The party label gathers that interior, spatial, temporal, and relational coherence into a form of belonging rather than a slogan.

activation_trace.role: Entry turns reward into relocation inside a new environment.
The tree-covered garden supplies sheltering abundance as the group's habitat.
Flow prevents the shelter from becoming static enclosure and gives it moving life.
Enduring stability supplies the temporal dimension of belonging.
Mutual satisfaction makes the final relation reciprocal rather than a one-sided reward ledger.
The aligned group branch names the people formed by this shared interior and destination.
Success as attainment and enduring good seals the whole habitat of belonging.

changed_reading.before: The ending is a list of rewards followed by a factional label.
changed_reading.after: The ending renders belonging as a whole habitat: inward support opens into covered, flowing, enduring reciprocity, and God's party names that lived alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first names God's limits after a graded sequence of repair, then repeatedly names active opposition to God and His messenger. This makes the focus opponent someone taking a stance over against a defining boundary; the boundary is norm-protective and reparative before it is adversarial.

activation_trace.role: The focus uses active opposition as the relation incompatible with reciprocal attachment.
The earlier plural limits supply a marked, differentiating boundary after concrete avenues of repair.
The first reuse converts the boundary image into deliberate opposition to God and the messenger.
The late recurrence keeps active opposition, not mere difference, as the immediate category before the focus.

structural_cues: 58:3-4 place release, fasting, or feeding before renewed intimacy, then call these God's limits.
The opposition formula recurs at 58:5 and 58:20 before its final appearance in 58:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the legal-limit sequence and exact root recurrence; I infer that active opposition means taking position across a protective norm. A live alternative is that the shared root gives thematic cohesion without importing the reparative function into the final use.

changed_reading.before: Opposition is generic hostility that triggers a free-standing demand for emotional severance.
changed_reading.after: Opposition is self-placement across God's defining boundary; because that boundary first regulates repair, the focus refusal is norm-protective rather than an autonomous ethic of antipathy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts secret counsel that crosses limits with a believing assembly that creates room, rises when asked, and incurs a material and purifying cost before private access. God's party is therefore bounded without being a closed clique: interior faith becomes anti-exclusion, mobility, and accountable counsel.

activation_trace.role: The aligned group is the focus model revised by the preceding ethics of gathering.
Secret counsel supplies the contracted social form that can conceal harmful solidarity.
Transgression as crossing a limit identifies what makes the hidden gathering corrupt.
The same private form is redirected rather than abolished, showing that social form is judged by its operating purpose.
Opening space gives the believing gathering an expansive rather than exclusionary mechanism.
Rising and moving from the assembly makes belonging compatible with yielding one's place.
The alms branch makes privileged private access materially accountable.
Purification of conduct frames that cost as cleansing the social use of privacy.

structural_cues: 58:9, 58:11, and 58:12 directly address those who believe while regulating counsel, space, and access.
Harmful secrecy is redirected into beneficial counsel, while public assembly is commanded to make room.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence from corrupt counsel to spacious assembly and accountable private access; I infer that these are enacted properties of the faith-community finally called God's party. The alternative is that meeting ethics and the final party designation remain adjacent but independent instructions.

changed_reading.before: God's party is primarily a bounded in-group defined by whom it excludes.
changed_reading.after: Its boundary also produces an expansive public ethic: it rejects conspiratorial solidarity, makes room, yields place, and makes private access accountable, so boundedness does not become clique formation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior scene embodies compromised belonging as chosen love-support-alliance with another people, secured rhetorically by false oaths. This shifts the focus mutual attachment toward enacted loyal solidarity with active opposition, while leaving involuntary kin feeling as a materially live narrower category.

activation_trace.role: Mutual love remains the focus's literal relational anchor.
Active opposition limits the scope to attachment directed toward a deliberate adversarial stance.
Love, support, and alliance combine in one branch, giving public operation to the focus's mutual attachment.
Oath-taking supplies the performative cover by which unstable allegiance claims legitimacy.
Falsehood exposes the claimed communal location as incoherent.

structural_cues: 58:14 describes the allied group as neither belonging to the addressees nor to the other people.
The focus changes from that unstable middle position to a positive, twice-named party belonging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a branch joining love, support, and alliance and a focus verb of mutual love; I infer that public loyal solidarity is the sharpened target. The live alternative is a broader reading that includes all deliberate affection, not only enacted alliance.

changed_reading.before: The verse forbids every affectionate feeling toward opposing relatives.
changed_reading.after: The context puts the weight on chosen reciprocal allegiance and support that falsify communal location; the verse need not deny involuntary kin feeling in order to deny loyal solidarity with active opposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposing group acquires oaths as a protective cover and uses that cover to turn others from a path. The focus answers with a garden from the same covering root, but this true shelter contains flowing life. Counterfeit cover blocks movement; received cover becomes a living destination.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate acquisition marks the oath-shield as a manufactured defensive strategy.
The oath branch identifies what is being converted into protection.
A shield or protective covering supplies the counterfeit shelter.
Turning away gives the false cover its obstructive output.
The extended traversable path is what the oath-shield prevents others from following.
The focus garden is the true covered environment set against the prior shield.
Flowing water reverses obstruction into sustained movement within the true shelter.

structural_cues: 58:16 places acquired oath, shield, obstruction, and path in one short causal sequence.
58:22 places divine entry, gardens, and flowing rivers in the corresponding positive destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact covering-root recurrence and the shield and garden branches; I infer a counterfeit-to-true-shelter reversal. The alternative is ordinary root polysemy without a designed contrast between the two coverings.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are an independent reward image unrelated to the opponents' behavior.
changed_reading.after: The gardens can answer the acquired oath-shield as true shelter: deceptive cover obstructs the path, while God-given cover opens into a habitat of flowing life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context groups wealth and offspring as resources that cannot provide sufficiency before God, then assigns a destination-based companionship. The focus's family list therefore de-absolutizes lineage as security and identity capital; it does not make real kinship itself worthless.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood keeps formative kinship visibly real within the test of ultimacy.
Sonship anchors the descendant relation that the prior context denies final sufficiency.
Brotherhood broadens the point beyond the offspring explicitly named in the prior verse.
Clan identity extends the non-sufficiency claim to the widest inherited collective.
Sufficiency is explicitly denied to the listed social and material resources.
Accumulated wealth supplies one form of security capital that fails.
Offspring from one's line supply the genealogical capital paired with wealth.
Companionship and abiding association shift belonging from biological possession to shared destination.

structural_cues: 58:17 denies that wealth or children avail anything before God and immediately names companions of the fire.
58:22 repeats descendant kin within a larger family topology and supplies the alternative party and garden destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the non-availing resource pair and the later kin list; I infer that the focus tests kinship's ultimacy rather than its reality. A narrower alternative is that 58:17 concerns protection from judgment while 58:22 concerns only direct conflict of loyalties.

changed_reading.before: The family list devalues family attachment itself.
changed_reading.after: The list de-absolutizes lineage as security capital: kin remain real bonds, but they cannot suffice before God or determine final companionship when they become vehicles of active opposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposing party is generated by an inward causal chain: takeover produces forgetting of remembrance, then party identity and loss. The focus reverses that chain with divine writing in the heart, living support, party identity, and flourishing. Party formation is a contest over what masters and scripts the interior.

activation_trace.role: Domination and takeover initiate the negative party-forming mechanism.
Loss of active remembrance is the inward effect of takeover.
Remembering after or against forgetting identifies the interior faculty being disabled.
The aligned group is the social consolidation produced by domination and forgetting.
General loss is the endpoint of the negative chain.
Divine inscription supplies the positive counterpart to imposed forgetting.
The heart locates the positive script in the same interior domain as the mnemonic contest.
Strengthening replaces takeover as the force acting on the interior.
God's aligned group is the social consolidation produced by inscription and support.
Flourishing and attainment reverse the prior party's terminal loss.

structural_cues: 58:19 and 58:22 each repeat a party label and close with opposed loss and flourishing outcomes.
The negative chain explicitly links takeover to caused forgetting, while the positive chain links writing to support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both causal sequences and their mirrored party outcomes; I infer that inward memory formation generates social alignment. A live alternative is that the mirrored wording contrasts labels and outcomes without asserting one unified psychology of party formation.

changed_reading.before: God's party and Satan's party are only externally identifiable factions.
changed_reading.after: A party is generated by what masters and scripts remembrance: takeover yields forgetting and loss, while divine inscription and support yield remembered allegiance and flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding written decree of divine-messenger victory is followed by faith written in hearts. Divine strength and strengthening become interior support by spirit. The macro decree is thus carried into persons as a durable inner orientation, and their success participates in an already authored outcome rather than manufacturing dominance.

activation_trace.role: Binding decree establishes the victory claim as authored and settled.
Prevailing force supplies the explicit outcome of the divine writing.
Strength gathered like rope-strands supplies a collective power image behind the decree.
Strengthening supplies the nearest contextual counterpart to the focus's divine support.
The same writing root relocates authored certainty from the preceding declaration into human hearts.
Divine support makes the preceding strength operative within the people.
Spirit renders the transferred strength living rather than coercively imitative.
Their attained success closes the movement from authored victory to interior participation.

structural_cues: 58:21 and 58:22 begin their positive claims with the same finite verb and divine subject.
The sequence moves directly from God as strong and strengthening to people supported with spirit from Him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate repetition of writing and the strength-support sequence; I infer macro decree becoming micro inscription. The alternative is a parallel of certainty, not a causal transfer from the global decree into each heart.

changed_reading.before: Heart-writing is an isolated spiritual gift followed by an unrelated promise of factional success.
changed_reading.after: The written decree of divine-messenger victory is internalized as written faith and living support; the party's success participates in that prior authorship rather than expressing self-generated domination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cleaving and farming are branch-distant from the conventional success sense of muflihun. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and in the adjacent boundary, garden, and flowing-water images. Downstream prose should present it only as secondary material wordplay, never as a replacement translation of success.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a defining boundary, covered gardens with flowing water, and the final word muflihun.

activation_trace.role: A marked boundary supplies the resistant edge at which separation occurs.
Cleaving or opening from a constriction supplies the exploratory material action behind success.
The ploughman branch turns cleavage into cultivation rather than mere rupture.
The garden supplies the cultivated environment made imaginable by opening the ground.
Flowing water supplies the irrigation-like movement that completes the material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Muflihun only closes the verse with an abstract label for winners.
changed_reading.after: As contained wordplay, their flourishing resembles cultivated cleavage: holding a difficult boundary opens ground for a covered, irrigated, enduring habitat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the idol-name branch is not the lexical sense of the focus verb of mutual affection. It remains attached to the exact w-d-d root and to the verse's repeated devotion pole in God. Downstream prose must qualify it as a resonance about attachment made ultimate, never claim that ordinary affection equals worship or that the verb means idolization.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places mutual attachment and repeated naming of God on opposite sides of active opposition.

activation_trace.role: The idol-name resonance lets an attachment made ultimate be tested as rival sacralization.
Worship and the worshipped supply the proper devotional pole repeatedly named throughout the focus.
Active opposition contains the resonance to attachments aligned against, not merely different from, devotion to God.

changed_reading.before: The conflict concerns only social preference among competing groups.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, loyal attachment to active opposition can become rival sacralization when made ultimate; the claim concerns absolutized attachment, not affection as such.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant j-d-d mapping for the opening w-j-d form, so it is form-distant and cannot control translation. It remains valid as packet-authorized root-play because the same focus immediately unfolds ancestry and clan. Downstream prose should call it a faint genealogical shadow on the finding clause, not a lexical sense of tajidu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening act of finding a people is followed by an exhaustive list of inherited relations.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping's ancestry branch casts a faint genealogical shadow over the act of finding.
The people being sought make communal identity the object of that shadowed finding.
Actual fatherhood gives the exploratory ancestry resonance an explicit focus anchor.
Lineage extends the ancestry shadow from predecessors into descendants.
Clan completes the inherited identity that cannot determine which people are coherently found.

changed_reading.before: The opening finding clause is a neutral observation before an unrelated family concession.
changed_reading.after: As faint root-play, the act of finding a qawm is shadowed by ancestry and then denies that inherited genealogy can supply the community's decisive identity.

strongest_changes: The repeated h-d-d root reframes opposition as deliberate placement across a boundary first presented through a reparative legal sequence.
The counsel and assembly sequence prevents God's party from being read as a closed clique; its boundary coexists with space-making and accountable access.
The oath-shield and garden share a covering root, producing a counterfeit-cover versus living-shelter reversal.
Satanic takeover, forgetting, party, and loss are reversed by divine inscription, support, party, and flourishing.
The written victory decree of 58:21 is carried into 58:22 as faith written in hearts and living support.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly turns the focus's stark allegiance claim into paired mechanisms: limit and opposition, secret contraction and spacious gathering, false shield and living garden, mnemonic capture and heart-inscription, external decree and interior support. The family list then reads as a test of what is ultimate, not a denial that kinship is real.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly shifts mutual affection toward enacted alliance, but the focus verb still literally carries love and may retain a broader deliberate-affection scope.
The h-d-d, j-n-n, and k-t-b recurrences may provide rhetorical cohesion without every proposed functional transfer being intentional.
The cultivation, idol-name, and ancestry activations are contained root-play and should never replace ordinary lexical readings.
The move from meeting ethics to the final party identity is coherent but remains an inferred pericope-level integration.
